experiment: S3 Minimum Sufficient Observation Model Closure
purpose: Answer what is the minimum but semantically complete Scope Observation Model. NOT a search for best score/weight/threshold, prediction, future return, or opportunity/risk ranking.

PRICE.role: top-level result fact layer (NOT a Trend score)

deletions_merges.reason: return_median and return_p50 are the same fact (identical values in S2: median=0.0077). One product field.
State categorical proportions ARE Breadth (Q1 SUPPORTED). Do not design a separate Breadth Score.
Ratio is the cross-scope core expression; raw counts remain EXPLANATORY/audit only.
raw HHI kept for single-scope time variation; normalized HHI for cross-scope comparison. Never averaged, no Concentration Score.
retain threshold-free volume/amount ratio distribution; P25/P50/P75 are one distribution object, not three dimensions. No active/high/low, no >1/>1.5, no Participation Score.

objects: Signed return contribution vs abs price share vs amount share
deletions_merges.reason: Different semantics are kept distinct even if correlated (per §5/§9). No correlation-based merge.

pqucv_scoring_judgment.criterion: Is there information that can ONLY be expressed through P/Q/U/C/V scores and that the observation model above cannot express?
pqucv_scoring_judgment.reason: No. Every P/Q/U/C/V score is an aggregation over the CORE observation facts already enumerated (return level/distribution/breadth, state+breadth, transition ratios, price/amount concentration, participation distributions). The observation model expresses all the underlying semantics directly; P/Q/U/C/V add no new information. Retaining them 'for aggregation convenience' is a summary-presentation choice, not an observation-model requirement.

distinction.summary_presentation: UI summaries / at-a-glance scores MAY remain as a presentation convenience. This is NOT part of the underlying observation model.
distinction.underlying_observation_model: P/Q/U/C/V are NOT needed as the first-layer observation model. The CORE objects above are the observation model.

evidence_window_note: All conclusions rest on a 6-day short window (2026-08-03..2026-08-10) plus exact-T1 same-day contrasts. Long-history stability is not established.
